title: Bengaluru Tech Park Targets Lower Power Costs with Rooftop Solar System
summary: Commercial buildings and technology parks are installing rooftop solar to bring down their electricity expenses and meet a larger share of their power needs on-site. Most such facilities have high daytime electricity usage due to air conditioning, elevators, lighting, server rooms, and other utilities. With on-site solar generation, they can offset a portion of their energy needs.
